# Microsoft Power Pages documentation

Create external-facing websites that allow users outside their organizations to sign in with a wide variety of identities, create and view data in Dataverse, or browse content anonymously.

## Sections

### Getting started
- Introducing Power Pages, capabilities, create and manage sites, security, architecture/security white papers, community

### Tutorials
- Tutorials/videos overview, Design home page, Set up brand kit, Create page with list, Create page with simple form, Configure site authentication

### Design and build
- Use the new design studio, Pages workspace, Styling workspace, Templates, Portal Management app, Visual Studio Code and Power Platform CLI, Plan your project

### AI and Copilot
- AI-powered and Copilot features overview
- Create AI-generated form using Copilot
- Add AI-generated text using Copilot
- Enable agent in your site
- Force Bing webmaster to index your site

### Connect to Dataverse
- What is Dataverse, Use the data workspace, Add lists, Add basic/multistep forms, Secure data with table permissions, Create/update/view Dataverse information

### Customize and extend
- Use Liquid, Web templates, Portals web API, Code components, Configure Power Automate cloud flows in your site, Advanced configuration

### Security
- Security overview, Set up authentication, Configure web roles, Configure table permissions, Architecture/security white papers

### Go live
- Go live checklist, Assign licensing, ALM overview

### Administer and monitor
- Portals admin center, Troubleshooting and diagnostics, Maintain and update, Review consumption
